breakdown.description: Constant-density (incompressible) assumption conflicts with a 10:1 pressure change in a gas.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not address the incompressible/constant-density assumption at all. It merely clarifies the pressure unit (1 bar = 1.0×10^5 Pa) without recognizing that a 10:1 pressure ratio in a gas requires compressible flow treatment with variable density and an equation of state. The fundamental inconsistency is completely unresolved.
